title: D CORE OT-ST597 PCIe x1 Single-Port M.2 M Key 2280 NVMe SSD Extended Card

items.h: Data Speed: M.2 NVMe 3.0 up to 4000MB/s
Bracket Height: Low Profile and Full Height

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The D CORE OT-ST597 is a compact and cost-effective PCIe x1 expansion card that allows you to add a high-speed M.2 NVMe SSD to your desktop system. Engineered for M-Key 2280 NVMe SSDs, this card fits into a standard PCI Express x1 slot, enabling easy upgrades without replacing existing drives or motherboards.

Whether you want to expand your storage, speed up your boot times, or build a compact workstation, the OT-ST597 is the perfect solution for users looking to enhance performance without hassle.

Key Features:

  • Model: OT-ST597

  • Interface: PCIe x1 (Compatible with x4, x8, x16 slots)

  • M.2 Slot: 1x M-Key (NVMe only)

  • Form Factor Supported: 2280 (80mm length)

  • Supported Protocol: NVMe (Not compatible with SATA M.2 SSDs)

  • Speed: Up to PCIe Gen3 x1 bandwidth

  • Build: Compact PCB with solid-state capacitors

  • Bracket: Standard height with heat ventilation support

  • Installation: Plug and Play (no driver required on modern OS)

FEATURES & BENEFITS:

  • Compliant with PCI Express specification Revision v3.0
  • PCI Express interface x1 bandwidth with 5Gb/s
  • Supports NVM Express (NVMe)
  • Support for single M.2 M Key PCIe Protocol NVMe SSD Drive
  • Supports M.2 SSD modules Sizes: 2230, 2242, 2260, 2280
  • Each port supports transmission speeds up to 4GB/s
  • M.2 Specification Revision 0.9
  • Automatic detection of lane configuration on boot-up
  • Onboard with LED indicator
  • The M.2 PCIe SSD gets its power supply from the motherboard PCIe BUS slot 3.3v
  • Operating temperature range: -40°C - +85°C
  • Support Operating System: Windows 10, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows Server 2012 R2, Linux, Fedora, SUSE, Ubuntu, Red-Hat. Native drivers support PCIe NVMe
  • No driver is required because the driver is transparent to the operating system
